units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 5b:2">B. Mets. 5ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:23">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>סתם ר׳ פסול</he> as a rule a herdsman (unless ascertained to be conscientious) is disqualified as witness.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:23">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ שאמרו אחד רוֹעֵה בהמה וכ׳</he> the shepherd who they said was unfit for legal action means both the shepherd of small cattle as well as the oxherd; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רוֹעִים</he>, <he>רוֹעִין</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>הוסיפו עליהן הר׳</he> the Rabbis added to them (the list of the disqualified) the shepherds.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:2">Ib. III, 2</cite> <he>נאמנין</he> … <he>רוֹעֵי בקר</he> I accept as judges three oxherds; a. v. fr.
